opening: My arm and leg muscles are weak.
I feel listless, with no energy.
After the ulcer was treated I still felt listless, and I had this weakness.
I've had several episodes of similar weakness before, brought on by exertion.
Three weeks ago an insect bit me on the left thigh.
The bite turned into a deep ulcer.
I needed surgery to clean out the ulcer.

opening.text: My arm and leg muscles are weak, and I feel listless with no energy. I had an insect bite on my left thigh three weeks ago that turned into a deep ulcer, and I needed surgery to clean it out. After the ulcer was treated, I still felt listless and had this weakness. I've had several episodes of similar weakness before, brought on by exertion.
